findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional. If machine B asks a question on an existing pull request while machine A has the item's worktree but no local question, `asking` is false here. A's `forge work` skips the pull request record and starts a worker round without an answer. That later `run start` also makes `wait_records.answered` treat B's question as answered, so A's Needs you view drops an open wait. The new test asks its second question on A and does not cover this handoff.
